summary: Profile-guided product copy authoring and rendered-text inspection; agent judgment with optional focused Jev signals.

help:
usage: st slopminer [-h] [--version]
                 {review,profile,inspect,jev-request,scope,classify,capture-script} ...

Find unclear, unnecessary or overloaded product copy.

positional arguments:
  {review,profile,inspect,jev-request,scope,classify,capture-script}
    review              Review a snapshot or supplied text against a profile
    profile             Validate a requirements profile
    inspect             Present a snapshot and all pending profile guidance
                        without evaluation
    jev-request         Compile a Jev request for the caller's managed
                        transport; does not dispatch
    scope               Select one complete captured component subtree
    classify            Compile or replay an experimental Jev classification
    capture-script      Print a read-only extractor for the caller's browser
                        eval capability

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit
help.review:
usage: st slopminer review [-h] [--input-format {snapshot,text}]
                        --profile PROFILE [--format {text,json}]
                        [--evaluator {local,deterministic,jev}]
                        [--jev-discovery JEV_DISCOVERY]
                        [--jev-evidence JEV_EVIDENCE]
                        [--jev-details JEV_DETAILS]
                        [--jev-compiler-version {1,2,3,4}] [--model MODEL]
                        [--ollama-url OLLAMA_URL]
                        [--context-length CONTEXT_LENGTH] [--timeout TIMEOUT]
                        [--task TASK]
                        input

positional arguments:
  input                 Input file, or - for stdin

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --input-format {snapshot,text}
  --profile PROFILE
  --format {text,json}
  --evaluator {local,deterministic,jev}
  --jev-discovery JEV_DISCOVERY
                        Saved budget-accounted Jev discovery response
  --jev-evidence JEV_EVIDENCE
                        Saved matching Jev primary-evidence response for
                        compiler 3 or 4
  --jev-details JEV_DETAILS
                        Saved matching Jev grounding/impact response, if
                        candidates were found
  --jev-compiler-version {1,2,3,4}
                        Jev request compiler version; 4 is opt-in and 1 or 2
                        replay older responses
  --model MODEL         Exact installed Ollama model name; required for local
                        review
  --ollama-url OLLAMA_URL
  --context-length CONTEXT_LENGTH
                        Explicit Ollama context allocation; otherwise use
                        runtime configuration
  --timeout TIMEOUT     Optional HTTP timeout in seconds; no retries
  --task TASK           Explicit reader task for this review

usage.cmd: st slopminer profile guidance PROFILE | st slopminer inspect SNAPSHOT --profile PROFILE
usage.when: writing or reviewing product UI copy, or performing a requested slop cleanup
precautions: Load the complete agreed profile before writing; use product-copy skill.
Inspect rendered text and coverage; deterministic success is not semantic approval.
Jev request compilation and replay are local; paid dispatch uses the separately authorized shared transport.
Agent judges usefulness and edits within authorization; verify UI visually.
